referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Based on the module for power saw without catalytic converter, adding some ceramics, platinum and rhodium to describe the catalytic converter.
referenceFunction.name: Power saw, with catalytic converter

technology.text: An average chainsaw weights about 7 kg. It is assumed that about 5.4 kg are unalloyed steel. The remaining 1.6 kg consists of the chain (0.4 kg) and the running rail (blade). Chain and running rail are made of highly alloyed steel. Service life of a chainsaw is around 2"500 service hours. The chain is replaced every 65 service hours; the running rail is replaced every 200 hours.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Most data obtained by personal communication. Data for the catalytic converter were extrapolated from data for car equipment.
